notes_for_editor: Thin: two list entries in Wayne County. 'odum' (GA179, gfc 807) and 'odum old' (GA373, with an unexplained 'datasheet BS1567' note); their coordinates are about 3 km apart. The list does not say how the two relate, so the story presents them side by side. The record's 45.4 m and 46.0 m assume feet. The page's notes say gfc numbers come from an older GFC list of 203 towers; GFC is not spelled out on the page, so the story keeps the abbreviation. The cited Georgia page does not name Tom Dunigan, so the story and footnote omit him. I read the full 29-name NHLR Georgia list; neither Odum entry is on it. No build, staffing or fate source found in two searches and the register pages. A Library of Congress HABS record for the Town of Odum mentions a 1992 demolition, but it concerns town buildings, not this tower, and is not used. Lead for a human: the Georgia Forestry Commission Wayne County unit. Story is about 141 words.
